scenarios.title: Study & Exam Question
scenarios.question: Which layer of the OSI model handles TCP segment sequencing and end-to-end flow control?
scenarios.ocrDetected:
Which layer of the OSI model handles TCP segment sequencing and end-to-end flow control?
A. Data Link Layer  B. Transport Layer  C. Session Layer  D. Network Layer
scenarios.explanation: The Transport Layer (Layer 4) is responsible for end-to-end communication, segment reordering, error checking, and flow control via protocols like TCP.

scenarios.title: Technical Interview Copilot
scenarios.question: Interviewer asks: 'Tell me about yourself and your experience designing high-throughput backend services.'
scenarios.groundedAnswer: I am a software engineer specializing in distributed systems and backend infrastructure. Over the past four years, I've designed low-latency data pipelines in Python and Go, scaled real-time messaging systems handling 60,000 requests per minute, and implemented zero-downtime deployment pipelines on AWS and Kubernetes.
scenarios.explanation: Answer generated in first-person candidate voice using saved profile experience without assistant preamble or hallucinated credentials.

scenarios.title: Live Code Analysis
scenarios.question: Given an array of integers nums and an integer target, return indices of the two numbers such that they add up to target in O(n) time.
scenarios.explanation: A single-pass hash map records seen values and indices. For each number, checking `target - num` lookup is O(1) average time, resulting in O(n) overall time complexity.
